- Keyboard: a space put in by itself after a full stop is the only thing a backspace takes (the full stop stays) and the next letter is not capitalised; file endings (py, kt, txt, json ...) after a dot are not split off as a new sentence.
- Music lists: Shuffle sits right beside Play.
- YouTube Music and Spotify covers: a video picture is cut to the square in its middle (no empty sides).
- Keyboard: the command words (ls, cd, git) only in a terminal (Termux) or Pulse's own editor; other apps get the usual words.
- Keyboard: a file waiting in the bar shows its name beside its tile.
- Task manager: a thin line between the rows of the process list.
- Files: recent files that were deleted leave the list.
